content.title: WrestleMania 42 Ticket Packages | On Location
content.text: The show of shows is headed back to Vegas, baby! The best way to catch every exhilarating moment at WrestleMania 42 is with a Priority Pass package from WWE's Official Fan Hospitality Provider, On Location! WrestleMania Priority Pass packages offer premium seating, unforgettable fan experiences with WWE Superstars, exclusive pre-show events, and unparalleled hospitality. Explore tabs for Two-Day Ticket Packages, Individual Event Ticket Packages, and a variety of Weekly Shows No, there is not a minimum age to attend the event. However, you will need to provide a valid ID to collect your credentials.You can choose your exact section and row during the purchase process, but the exact seat location will not be confirmed until the tickets are in your possession. Your mobile tickets will be transferred to the email address on file the week of the event. You will then be directed to create a Ticketmaster account if you do not yet have one using the email address that was used during your purchase. Availability and type of accessible seating tickets will vary based on each venue’s policies and/or the type of event taking place. If you would like to inquire about accessible seating, please reach out to us at guestservices@onlocationexp.com or 855-346-7388 prior to purchase. We will go over any available options. Parking is not included with our packages, across all of the events/inclusions for WrestleMania. Parking may be available through the venue directly. Please refer to each venue’s website for more information regarding parking. When will I find out the timing for all of the amazing elements included with my purchase? Superstars have not yet been finalized and are typically a surprise! As Superstars are confirmed*, we will update our website accordingly! While we aim to facilitate memorable interactions with the Superstars, we cannot guarantee that you will meet or interact with every Superstar in attendance. In line with the WWE’s policies, autographs are not permitted. *Please note, Superstar appearances are subject to change.If your package* includes the WWE Priority Pass Ring Mat Plaque, this will be shipped to the billing address on file in the months following the event. All other souvenirs will be distributed at check-in. If you need to update your address for shipment, please contact our Guest Services team at guestservices@onlocationexp.com or 855-346-7388 prior to the event. *Please note – Silver Ticket + Priority Passes do not include the Ring Mat Plaque or Collector’s Item.If your package includes a WWE Priority Pass and Lanyard, this will be picked up on-site at our welcome table. You will receive further details on this approximately 5-7 days prior to the event date. All Priority Pass purchasers have a dedicated entry point to Allegiant Stadium. Although this is not an expedited entry, this is where you will check in, meet our staff, and collect your credentials! The exact location will be shared in your itinerary approximately 5-7 days prior to the event. As the official hospitality provider of the WWE, all of our ticket packages include hospitality. If you are interested in booking tickets only, we recommend reaching out to the venue directly. Packages are all-inclusive and cannot be customized or modified. If you are looking to enhance your WrestleMania weekend, please take a look at our Add-On Experiences!You can transfer your event tickets through the digital platform. That said, you will need to contact us at guestservices@onlocationexp.com or 855-346-7388 at least 1 week prior to the event date to update the guest’s name on file for the Priority Pass credentials. All Priority Pass events are subject to the WWE’s bag/security policy. For further details, please check out their website.Yes, you can contact us at 855-346-7388 and a representative will gladly assist you! Yes! You may pay in full at the time of purchase or secure your package with a 1/3 deposit. The second 1/3 will be charged to the card on file automatically on 2/1/2026, with the final 1/3 being charged automatically on 3/1/2026. Please note, payment plans will not be available after the final payment date. All packages are sold as non-refundable per the On Location Purchase Policy .All hotel packages will include a pass for the Las Vegas Monorail. 3-Night packages will include a 3-Day Monorail Pass (Fri-Sun), and 4-Night packages will include a 4-day pass (Fri-Mon). Please note- the Las Vegas Monorail runs the length of The Strip but does not go directly to Allegiant Stadium. You cannot select your exact seating location. You are guaranteed within the category that is listed under your ticket category. If you are interested in an All-Inclusive travel package and would like to select your specific section and row, please reach out to our Guest Services team who will go over any available options. No, there is no minimum age to buy WrestleMania tickets or attend the event. However, a valid ID will be required to collect your Priority Pass credentials. Please note, for packages including a hotel stay, you must be 21+ to check into the room. If you are interested in adding additional nights to your travel package, please reach out to our Guest Services team at guestservices@onlocationexp.com and we will relay available options. WrestleMania hotel packages do not include tickets to the event. WrestleMania 42 tickets must be purchased separately from our hotel packages. Join us in the heart of Las Vegas for an unforgettable event featuring WWE Superstars and Legends, exclusive merchandise, and interactive experiences. See live programming, and re-live 42 years of WrestleMania history through memorabilia museums and immersive exhibits. • Silver, Gold, and Suite by the Seat packages include 4-Day GA passes valid Friday-Monday. • Champion packages include 5-day VIP passes valid Thursday-Monday. Your WWE World passes will be transferred digitally, using the email address on file, the week of the event.Priority Pass WWE World packages include the Dedicated WWE World/Superstore Entrance and Dedicated Express Checkout Lane. The specific location, and directions to WWE World, will be shared in your event itinerary, which will be sent approximately 5-7 days prior to the event. All autograph sessions and meet & greets are offered/managed by Fanatics. Please keep an eye on their website for further information!
